preconditions.expression: h >= 2 and w >= 2 and q >= 1 and q <= 10000
preconditions.description: Grid dimensions h and w are at least 2, and number of days q is between 1 and 10000.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == w for row in grid_lines)
preconditions.description: Each of the h grid rows has exactly w characters.

preconditions.expression: all(cell in {'.', '#'} for row in grid_lines for cell in row)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the grid is either allowed ('.') or permanently blocked ('#').
Limak's house (top-left cell) and school (bottom-right cell) are never permanently blocked.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ri <= h and 1 <= cj <= w for day in days for (ri, cj) in day['temporary_blocks'])
preconditions.description: Temporary blocks for each day are within grid bounds.

preconditions.expression: all((ri, cj) != (1, 1) and (ri, cj) != (h, w) for day in days for (ri, cj) in day['temporary_blocks'])
preconditions.description: Temporary blocks never include Limak's house or school.

preconditions.expression: all(grid_lines[ri-1][cj-1] == '.' for day in days for (ri, cj) in day['temporary_blocks'])
preconditions.description: Temporary blocks are only on allowed cells (not permanently blocked).

postconditions.expression: all(output_line in {'YES', 'NO'} for output_line in stdout_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is either 'YES' or 'NO'.
Each output line has exactly 3 characters ('YES' or 'NO').
The number of output lines equals the number of days q.

postconditions.expression: all(has_valid_path(grid_lines, day['temporary_blocks']) == (output_line == 'YES') for day, output_line in zip(days, stdout_lines))
postconditions.description: For each day, 'YES' is output if and only if there exists a valid path from house to school and back without revisiting cells (except house).
